column12: Corrected on verification from 0.2704, which counted seven stops rather than the full text's nine and treated all 48 as followed for six months. Case for lower: other C5 cohorts stop less, ravulizumab 3 of 24 over a median 26 weeks of follow-up (Italian early access, J Neurol 2025, PMID 40366475, about 0.22 a year) and eculizumab 13 of 36 over a mean 35 months of treatment (Japan MG registry, Ann Clin Transl Neurol 2024, PMID 38572524, about 0.12 a year); pooled over the three cohorts, 25 stops over about 137 patient-years is about 0.17 a year. Case for higher: early-access patients are refractory and closely watched. The peak is solved to a published forecast, so this rate sets the shape of the climb and the patient count, not the peak

column11: Two filters for the label population, 'adult patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) who are anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibody-positive' (Regeneron release of 2026-06-22). (1) Generalised, not ocular-only: 'A recent population-based study conducted by the Mayo Clinic found that 51% of patients presented with ocular onset, and 55% of these developed generalized symptoms' (Dresser L et al., J Clin Med 2021;10(11):2235, doi:10.3390/jcm10112235, section 3.1.2), so 1 - 0.51 x 0.45 = 0.7705 are generalised. (2) AChR antibody-positive within gMG: 'Eighty-five percent of people with gMG are AChR antibody-positive' (AstraZeneca 6-K 0001654954-26-008478, 2026-09-21, Klygefa CHMP release). 0.7705 x 0.85 = 0.6549, or 54,172 US adults
column12: Cross-check from Dresser alone: 'Antibodies against the AChR are found in approximately 80% of MG patients', consistent. No severity filter: NIMBLE required MG-ADL of 6 or more, but the filed population carries none. Case against: payers may restrict to more severe patients. The peak is solved to a published forecast on this same pool, so the filter sets the patient share, not the revenue. Case for lower: cemdisiran enters behind three anti-FcRn drugs and three C5 inhibitors, with gefurulimab also under US review (AstraZeneca 6-K 0001654954-26-008478)
